top_signals.title: Ali Yasin: Iran War Forces GCC Firms to Rethink IPOs
top_signals.summary: Kuwait's Agility Public Warehousing also known as Makhazen is the latest firm in the UAE to consider delisting from the Dubai Financial Market. This comes as Dubai's largest developer, Emaar Properties, announced plans to buy the rest of its listed construction arm at a valuation of $16.3 billion. Mohammed Ali Yasin, CEO of Ghaf Benefits spoke to Bloomberg’s Paul Allen on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the latest wave of delisiting in the UAE. (Source: Bloomberg)
